Meir Orbach 13:43, 07.06.26 Zencity is laying off 15-20 employees out of its 130-person workforce, 70 of whom are based in Israel. The employees affected are mostly in development, product, and professional services roles. In 2022, the company carried out another significant round of layoffs that affected about 20% of its workforce. Full list of Israeli high-tech layoffs in 2026 The company was founded in 2015 by Ido Ivri and Eyal Feder leverages technology to analyze resident discourse across multiple information channels. The company has launched a tool that simulates the work of a municipal analyst, enabling various public participation activities to be automated, including creating quick polls and satisfaction surveys, establishing and managing public engagement websites, analyzing data, monitoring social media, and generating comprehensive reports that integrate information from multiple sources. 1 View gallery Eyal Feder. ( Photo: Zencity ) Since its inception, the company has raised $91 million from investors, including StepStone Group and TLV Partners.
